name: Effective Range / Oriented Diameter
details: Every coordinate in an oriented pair is active.
proof: If an oriented pair \(\emptyset,S\) is realized in a projection, its two realizing concepts differ on every coordinate of S. Thus S is contained in the effective range. Maximizing gives \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm D^+(\mathcal H)\).
witness_verification: For #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
